python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
print(len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for i,x in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start+1):
  w=Image.open(x['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(x['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  row=Image.new('RGB',(max(1400,w.width+20,l.width+20),w.height+l.height+45),'white')
  ImageDraw.Draw(row).text((5,3),str(i)+' '+x['item_id'],fill='black')
  row.paste(w,(10,25));row.paste(l,(10,30+w.height));rows.append(row)
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(max(r.width for r in rows),sum(r.height for r in rows)),'white'); y=0
 for r in rows:sheet.paste(r,(0,y));y+=r.height
 sheet.save('zoom/b%02d.png'%(start//5+1))
PY

cat > zoom/record.py <<'PY'
import json,sys
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
with open('zoom/labels.txt','a') as f:f.write(sys.argv[1]+'\n')
labels=[x.split() for x in open('zoom/labels.txt') if x.strip()]
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for item,p in zip(items,labels):
  b,a=p[:2]; conf=p[2] if len(p)>2 else 'high'
  ans=dict(item_id=item['item_id'],breathing=next(k for k,v in item['breathing_options'].items() if v==b),accent=next(k for k,v in item['accent_options'].items() if v==a),confidence=conf,note='')
  f.write(json.dumps(ans)+'\n')
print('Recorded',len(labels))
